notes.title: Usage review with Siobhan
notes.content: She sounded keen on the bigger plan.
notes.plan:
Siobhan's team doubled its usage this quarter and wants to talk renewal.

## Key Discussion Points
- Usage doubled since the summer.
- The bigger plan would cover the new team.

## Decisions Made
- Keep the current price until the renewal.

## Action Items
- [ ] You: draft the renewal contract (due: 5 November)
- [ ] Siobhan: send the latest usage report
- [x] You: share the plan comparison

## Follow-ups
- Check whether the new team needs its own admin.
